title: English Premier League: results and tables (openfootball)
what: Every English Premier League match openfootball holds from the 2010-11 season on, with the full-time and half-time scores, and a league table for each season computed from them.

schedule.how: once a day at a wake: one GET per season file (17 seasons, 2.5 s apart) from raw.githubusercontent.com, no key

terms.summary: Public domain: openfootball dedicates the football.json schema, data and scripts to the public domain (CC0 1.0 Universal in LICENSE.md). Free for any use, commercial included; credit given as a courtesy.
terms.quote: The football.json schema, data and scripts are dedicated to the public domain. Use as you please with no restrictions whatsoever.
terms.read_by: data.d@PrompTugal.dinis (README.md and LICENSE.md at commit e674442, 22 Nov 2026)

code: the collector reads each season file and computes the tables; no model
agents: data.d@PrompTugal.dinis wrote the collector and card on 22 November 2026, at Dinis's word (football, Strictly and Wikipedia, then connect the dots)
people: no person has checked the values (not reviewed); openfootball's volunteers keep the source

cost.note: Code only: no model is called when the data is collected.
